text:
Records Aide on the Companion Animal Travel Desk acknowledges your complaint that your animal handling experience on an Aurelia Skyways journey was not managed with the care and promptness you expected. We note your account and have logged it for immediate review by the relevant welfare coordinator and cabin team, who are responsible for animal comfort needs and in-flight monitoring.

Please be advised that escape in transit claim submissions remain open for 59 days after the incident, and any filing outside that window cannot be accepted. Please also note that escape in transit carries a standard payout of $438 when the review confirms eligibility under the applicable terms.

We understand that a travel disruption involving a companion animal can be distressing and frustrating, and we regret that your experience fell short of the standard expected from Aurelia Skyways. Your report will remain in the file while the review proceeds, and any supporting documents you provide will be attached to the record without delay. If you have already sent materials, no further action is needed from you at this time beyond awaiting the outcome. If you have not yet submitted the required claim material, do so at once so the matter can be processed without avoidable hold.

Records Aide Companion Animal Travel Desk
